title: Chapter 420: War Preparation
content:
Chapter 420: War Preparation

When everyone left, only Lu Xue and Shi Tianzhi were left in the courtyard.

Shi Tianzhi stood there, obviously a little cramped.

He found that Lu Xue has changed a lot now. When he saw her before, she was still a little girl with a stinky breast, but now she has grown into a big man who feels oppressive when she sees her.

Sure enough, a tiger father has no dog daughter.

Shi Tianzhi thought of this in his heart, and then he silently looked at Lu Xue who was paced back and forth in front of him.

After a long time, Lu Xue stopped and looked at Shi Tianzhi and asked, "Did my father tell you anything else?"

Hearing this question, Shi Tianzhi took a deep breath, and a trace of helplessness appeared in his eyes. No, it was more like despair.

Lu Xue swallowed unconsciously, and her expression became nervous unconsciously.

I heard Shi Tian say quietly, "The City Lord tells me that the world is going to be destroyed."

Is the world going to be destroyed?

Lu Xue was stunned and stood there in a daze, speechless for a long time.

If someone told her this, she would definitely disdain.

But Shi Tianzhi told her that this was what her father said.

Will she believe it?

The answer is yes.

Her father could not say such irresponsible words.

At this time, a strange movement came from Lu Xue's sleeves, and Ao Qing came out inappropriately. He looked at Shi Tianzhi, then looked at Lu Xue, and finally laughed, "This joke is really funny."

......

The scene fell silent, and Ao Qing's face gradually changed from a smile to a very ugly expression.

Lu Xue sighed, stroked Ao Qing's head, and said nothing.

She really didn't know how to comfort Ao Qing, because she was also a little at a loss now.

The world is about to be destroyed, so should she enjoy the rest of her life now?

And just as she was thinking about it, Ao Qing suddenly laughed again, and he laughed crazy, even a little evil.

"Hahahahahahahaha..."

"this,,"

Shi Tianzhi looked at Ao Qing at this moment and his face was stunned.

Lu Xue was stunned for a moment and quickly punched Ao Qing on the head.

There was a snap.

Ao Qing was knocked down to the ground, with stars emerging from her eyes.

"Sharp, damn, little master, why did you sneak attack me?"

Lu Xue said with a gloomy face: "Who made you laugh so slutty? I thought you were obsessed with it."

Ao Qing stood up and shook his head, explaining, "I just suddenly figured out one thing."

When Lu Xue heard Ao Qing's words, he was a little surprised, "Oh? Tell me, what's the matter?"

Just Ao Qing, who is a little head, can figure out what is going on.

Ao Qing smiled and said, "The reason why my master said this is definitely to stimulate us to become stronger quickly and not live such a comfortable life."

Hearing this, Lu Xue frowned slightly and glared at Ao Qing and said, "What do you mean is that my father scaring us?"

"No, no, no."

Ao Qing shook his head and continued, "The master did not lie to us. The world may really be destroyed, but he did not finish it."

"He may have found a solution now, but he just didn't say it."

"You don't think about what kind of strength the master is. Not to mention the world is destroyed, even if the world is reorganized, it is probably planned by the master."

Ao Qing had confidence on his face, and he no longer had the fear and despair he had when he first heard the destruction of the world.

As long as you think of Lu Daosheng's strength, the destruction of the world will not interfere with his safety.

No surprises are there.

Listening to Ao Qing's exaggerated words, Lu Xue and Shi Tianzhi actually felt a trace of reality.

It seems to be possible.

However, this is more of a kind of comfort to oneself.

Lu Xue slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air and said, "Let's let go of the destruction of the world first. The most urgent task is to deal with the land of the gods."

Back then, Lu Daosheng released all the elites in the deserted city and developed their own development, in order to one day deal with the land of gods.

Now it seems that it is almost time for them to come back.

Unfortunately, Lu Daosheng will not participate in the war.

Of course, if Lu Daosheng really wants to join the war, then there will be no problem with them.

And just then, an escort came outside the courtyard and spoke respectfully: "Miss Lu Xue, I regret it when I am here in the Human Emperor Palace."

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked out and said, "Let him come in."

Outside the courtyard, a handsome man was bent and waiting outside.

Just recently, he was still in the Human Emperor Hall, high above.

Until a black shadow who claimed to be a root organization informed him of Lu Xue's summoning him.

Then, he immediately put down the matter in his hand and rushed over without stopping.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Wu Hui pinched his fist, took a deep breath, lowered his head slightly and entered the courtyard.

"I'm sorry, I've met the first palace master!"

Wu Hui knelt on one knee with a respectful look.

"Get up."

"Thank you, Lord."

Lu Xue did not refuse Wu Hui's call her the palace master.

Lu Xue has already basically understood what Wu Hui has done after he took office in recent years.

His eyes were on Wu Hui, and Lu Xue's eyes moved slightly.

I have to say that Wu Hui is very outstanding. Wu Shang is really good at training apprentices.

In recent years, Wu Hui not only did not divide the human race's strength, but also consolidated the rights of the Human Emperor Palace. Of course, it was exchanged for the sacrifice of the Wu family.

Except for the human race, the rest are basically all good.

Wu Hui has really tried his best.

“You have done a great job over the years.”

Lu Xue suddenly spoke.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Wu Hui's body trembled and his head lowered even lower.

His eyes were slightly moist, and he had not been in vain for Lu Xue's recognition in recent years.

At this moment, even if Lu Xue asked him to step down, he had no complaints.

But Lu Xue did not have such a plan.

Although the human race is extremely powerful in the Chaos Realm, it is probably just that in the eyes of the Gods.

Afterwards, Lu Xue informed the Chaos Realm that there would be powerful enemies invading.

Upon hearing this news, Wu Hui looked solemn.

"The Lord of the Palace, the human race is willing to advance and retreat with the Chaos Realm."

Lu Xue smiled and said, "If the human race in the Chaos Realm also participates in this battle, it may be a battle of all the family."

"Even if you try the last trace of blood from the human race, you will definitely resist to the end!"

Wu Hui's voice was firm and his eyes were full of sharpness.

"Okay, my human race is indeed all the dragons and phoenixes among people."

"But there is no need to do this."

The human race cannot fully participate in this upcoming war.

Of course, it is impossible for humans to go to the Chaos Realm to be the only ones.

You should know that although the human race has the strongest strength, it is not too weak as the former strong races.

"Declare the world, the Chaos Realm has entered a state of preparation for war and is released in the name of the deserted city."

"Yes, the Lord of the Palace."
